data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit, Shresthav means 'the best' or 'the most excellent'. The name Shresthav carries the meaning “The Best” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shresthav usually hope their child will grow to embody the best and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pursuit of excellence and the divine.
data.etymology: Shresthav belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Best.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shresthav total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

It symbolizes the ideal state of enlightenment - being the best that one can be, according to one's unique divine potential. It represents the journey towards the ultimate goal of self-realization and self-transcendence. vedic_reference.note: From the Sanskrit roots स्था (sthā) and स्थानम् (sthānam), meaning 'to stand' and 'place, position' respectively.

historical_references.reference: The Shresthavs were a prominent Kshatriya (warrior) clan in the northern Indian region of Uttar Pradesh during the medieval period. They held significant power and influence in the political landscape of the region.
historical_references.context: Political power and influence in northern India

historical_references.reference: The Shresthavs are also mentioned in ancient Hindu texts, particularly the Mahabharata, as descendants of the lunar dynasty (Chandra Vansha). In the epic, they are listed among the great warriors and noble families of ancient India.
historical_references.context: Ancestry and nobility in Hindu epics
